catalogue: Aggregated Aggregates range expansion — ROADMAP Phase 2 (docs/pricing/RANGE_EXPANSION.md)
source_note: Range expansion (ROADMAP Phase 2), compiled 2026-10-23: a standard South African trade type and size, not yet confirmed with a named supplier. Make, size, finish, price and availability are confirmed with the supplier on the quote.

categories.name: Treated Poles, Droppers & Laths
categories.description: SANS 457 CCA- and creosote-treated eucalyptus and pine poles from 50 to 250 mm diameter and 1.8 to 9 m long, half-rounds, droppers, laths and vineyard poles.
typical_uses: Lapas, shade structures and pole buildings
categories.handling_notes: Treated timber must carry the treater's brand and hazard class. Wear gloves and a dust mask when cutting, treat every cut end with preservative, and never burn off-cuts of CCA- or creosote-treated timber.

categories.name: Engineered Timber & Glulam
categories.description: Glued-laminated (glulam) beams from 65 × 180 to 135 × 630 mm, timber I-joists, LVL, finger-jointed PAR pine and laminated pine panels.
categories.handling_notes: Store engineered timber flat on bearers, under cover and dry. Glulam and LVL sizes are designed by an engineer for the span and load — send the drawing with your quote.

categories.name: Hardwoods & PAR Timber
categories.description: Meranti and saligna planed all round (PAR) from 19 × 44 to 76 × 76 mm, and pine PAR — for door and window frames, joinery and trims, sold per metre.
categories.handling_notes: Keep hardwood flat, under cover and out of the sun until it's fixed. Pre-drill hardwood for nails and screws near the ends, and seal or oil exposed faces.

categories.name: Decking, Cladding & Battens
categories.description: Treated pine, balau and garapa decking, composite deck boards, deck joists and screws, shiplap, log-lap and tongue-and-groove cladding and ceiling boards, and battens.
typical_uses: Battens for roofing, ceilings and boards
categories.handling_notes: Leave decking stacked flat with spacers for a few days on site before fixing, keep 5 mm gaps between boards, use stainless or coated deck screws, and oil the deck before and after laying.

categories.name: Industrial & Mining Timber
categories.description: Mining props and pack timber, treated pine and hardwood sleepers, and crate, pallet and rough-sawn industrial timber by the cubic metre.
categories.handling_notes: Industrial and mining timber is sold by the load. Specifications (species, moisture, treatment and tolerances) follow the buyer's or mine's specification — send it with the quote.

categories.name: Carport, Pergola & Lapa Kits
categories.description: Treated-pole and sawn-timber kits for single and double carports, pergolas from 3 × 3 to 6 × 6 m and round lapas from 5 to 10 m — poles, beams, purlins and fixings, with roofing to order.
categories.handling_notes: Kits are supplied unassembled with a parts list. Footings, height and any roofing are confirmed on the quote — structures over the National Building Regulations' exemptions need approved plans.

categories.name: Instant Lawn & Lawn Seed
categories.description: Kikuyu, LM, buffalo, Cynodon, Zoysia, paspalum and kweek instant lawn per m² or by the pallet, and lawn seed — delivered fresh from the grower.
categories.handling_notes: Instant lawn is perishable: lay it on the day it arrives, on prepared, levelled and watered soil, and water daily for the first two weeks. Delivery days follow the grower's cutting schedule.

categories.name: Soils, Compost & Mulch
categories.description: Topsoil, compost, manure, lawn dressing, potting and seedling mixes, bark nuggets and mulch, vermiculite and perlite — bagged, or bulk by the m³ on a tipper.
categories.handling_notes: Bulk soils are delivered by tipper and tipped where the truck can reach — keep the drop-off clear. Bagged growing media keep best out of the sun and rain.

categories.name: Fertiliser & Lawn Care
categories.description: Lawn and garden fertilisers (7:1:3, 2:3:2, 3:1:5, LAN, superphosphate), slow-release and organic feeds, bonemeal, garden lime and weed-and-feed — from 2 to 50 kg.
categories.handling_notes: Fertilisers are registered under the Fertilizers Act (Act 36 of 1947): follow the label rates, water in after spreading, and store bags dry, sealed and away from children and animals.

categories.name: Irrigation, Sprinklers & Hoses
categories.description: LDPE irrigation pipe and insert fittings, drip line and drippers, pop-up sprays and rotors, impact and garden sprinklers, controllers, solenoid valves, filters, garden hose and fittings.
categories.handling_notes: Design the system by zone so each valve's flow stays within your water supply — we confirm pipe sizes and zones on the quote. Flush pipes before fitting emitters and nozzles.

categories.name: Planters, Edging & Artificial Grass
categories.description: Fibre-cement, concrete and plastic planters, raised beds, plastic, steel and timber edging, artificial grass from 20 to 40 mm pile, trellis panels and garden arches.
categories.handling_notes: Artificial grass goes down on a compacted, levelled and drained base (crusher dust or G5 with a weed barrier). Planters need drainage holes and a free-draining layer.

categories.name: Garden Tools & Power Garden Equipment
categories.description: Forks, rakes, hoes, secateurs, loppers and shears, watering cans and sprayers, and electric and petrol lawnmowers, brushcutters, trimmers, hedge trimmers, chainsaws and blowers.
categories.handling_notes: Wear eye and hearing protection with power garden equipment, keep blades sharp and guarded, and mix two-stroke fuel at the ratio on the machine.

categories.name: Braais, Fireplaces & Flues
categories.description: Built-in and freestanding braais, gas braais, braai grids and grates, closed-combustion fireplaces, flue pipe, bends and cowls, firebricks, fireclay and heat-resistant mortar.
categories.handling_notes: Fireplaces and flues must be installed to SANS 10400-V (space heating) by a competent installer, with the flue clear of thatch and timber by the distances required. Build braai and fireplace linings with firebricks and fireclay, never ordinary mortar.

categories.name: Shade Sails, Carports & Patio Cover
categories.description: Shade sails, shade-net carport kits, twin-wall polycarbonate sheets and profiles in clear, bronze and opal, aluminium patio roof kits and sail hardware.
typical_uses: Patios, pool areas and play areas
categories.handling_notes: Shade structures over 20 m² and carports need to comply with the National Building Regulations — your municipality may need plans. Tension sails at the corners with stainless hardware and allow for wind load.

categories.name: Pools, Pool Care & Water Features
categories.description: Pool pumps and sand filters, filter media, marbelite and pebble finishes, waterline tiles and coping, chlorine, acid and pool chemicals, cleaners, covers and salt chlorinators, pond pumps and liners.
categories.handling_notes: Pool chemicals are hazardous: store them dry, cool and apart (never mix chlorine and acid), add chemicals to water and not water to chemicals, and keep them away from children. Pool pumps must be wired by a registered electrician.

categories.name: Outdoor Finishes & Garden Lighting
categories.description: Paving and stone sealers, decking oils and exterior timber finishes, anti-slip coatings, wall, bollard and spike lights, solar garden lights and outdoor LED strips.
categories.handling_notes: Seal paving and oil decks on a dry day, on clean surfaces, as the maker's instructions say. Outdoor mains lighting must be IP-rated for exterior use and installed by a registered electrician.

categories.name: Formwork Ties, Cones & Accessories
categories.description: Tie rods and wing nuts, cones and plugs, she-bolts, column formers, void formers, chamfer and drip strips, spacers, form oil and release agents.
typical_uses: Tanks, retaining walls and civil structures
categories.handling_notes: Formwork, props and scaffolding must be designed, erected, inspected and used as the Construction Regulations (2014) require, by a competent person, on firm bearing. Check every component for damage before use.

categories.name: Props, Shoring & Formwork Beams
categories.description: Adjustable steel props in five ranges, fork heads, tripods and base plates, H20 timber and aluminium formwork beams, shoring frames and trench shoring — for sale or hire.
categories.handling_notes: Formwork, props and scaffolding must be designed, erected, inspected and used as the Construction Regulations (2014) require, by a competent person, on firm bearing. Check every component for damage before use.

categories.name: Ladders, Towers & Trestles
categories.description: Aluminium and fibreglass stepladders, extension and combination ladders, platform ladders, mobile aluminium towers, trestles, hop-ups and scaffold boards.
categories.handling_notes: Ladders must suit the job and be inspected before use (SANS 50131 / EN 131). Use fibreglass ladders near electricity, set extension ladders at 1-in-4, and use a tower or scaffold for long work at height.

categories.name: Asphalt, Bitumen & Road Repair
categories.description: Cold-mix asphalt in bags and bulk, anionic and cationic bitumen emulsions, prime and tack coats, penetration-grade bitumen, crack sealants and pothole repair.
categories.handling_notes: Bitumen products are applied in dry weather at the temperatures and rates on the data sheet. Heated bitumen burns — use PPE and keep emulsions from freezing. Larger road works follow the road authority's specification.

categories.name: Road Marking & Road Studs
categories.description: Water- and solvent-borne road-marking paint in white, yellow and red, thermoplastic, retro-reflective glass beads, road studs and cat's eyes, kerb paint and parking-bay stencils.
categories.handling_notes: Mark on a clean, dry surface above the paint's minimum temperature, and drop glass beads into wet paint for night visibility. Markings on public roads must follow the SADC Road Traffic Signs Manual.

categories.name: Traffic Cones, Barriers & Signs
categories.description: Traffic cones from 450 to 1,000 mm, delineators, water-filled and mesh barriers, flashing lights, temporary road-works signs, stop/go boards, speed humps and wheel stops.
categories.handling_notes: Temporary traffic control on public roads follows the SADC Road Traffic Signs Manual (Volume 2, Chapter 13) and the road authority's approved plan. Inspect cones and signs for reflectivity.

categories.name: Survey & Setting-Out Equipment
categories.description: Timber pegs and steel pins, profile boards, builder's line, marking paint, measuring tapes and wheels, dumpy and laser levels, staffs, tripods and ranging rods.
categories.handling_notes: Keep instruments in their cases and check levels and lasers for calibration before setting out. Mark services before digging — call the municipality for underground services.

categories.name: Erosion Control, Sandbags & Silt Fencing
categories.description: Woven polypropylene sandbags, biodegradable erosion-control mats, coir logs and blankets, silt fence and hydroseeding mixes — with geotextiles and gabions from drainage.
categories.handling_notes: Install erosion and sediment control before earthworks start, keyed into the ground on the contour, and maintain it after every storm.

categories.name: Hollow-Core & Rib-and-Block Slabs
categories.description: Prestressed hollow-core slabs from 150 to 250 mm, rib-and-block suspended floors (beams and infill blocks), precast staircases, landings and beams — designed and made to order.
categories.handling_notes: Precast units are lifted only at the lifting points with the right equipment and placed on prepared bearing, as the engineer's design requires. Delivery is by crane truck — confirm access and offloading space with the quote.

categories.name: Road Barriers, Bollards & Cable Ducts
categories.description: Precast New Jersey barriers, concrete bollards, cable ducts and draw boxes, cable-pit covers, precast palisade and fence-post bases, concrete wheel stops and sleeper walls.
categories.handling_notes: Precast units are lifted only at the lifting points with the right equipment and placed on prepared bearing, as the engineer's design requires. Delivery is by crane truck — confirm access and offloading space with the quote.

categories.name: Precast Walls, Septic & Conservancy Tanks
categories.description: Precast panel boundary walls from 1.2 to 2.4 m high, precast septic and conservancy tanks, soakaway rings and precast water and feed troughs.
typical_uses: Boundary walls for homes, estates and farms
On-site sanitation where there's no sewer
categories.handling_notes: Precast units are lifted only at the lifting points with the right equipment and placed on prepared bearing, as the engineer's design requires. Delivery is by crane truck — confirm access and offloading space with the quote. Septic and conservancy tanks need municipal approval (SANS 10400-P).

categories.name: Concrete Repair, Curing & Floor Treatments
categories.description: Curing compounds, bonding agents, structural and cosmetic repair mortars, self-levelling screeds, dry-shake floor hardeners, concrete sealers and densifiers, epoxy floor coatings and surface retarders.
categories.handling_notes: Read the product data and safety data sheets before use: mix, apply and cure at the temperatures and rates they give, wear gloves and eye protection, and store sealed, cool and dry. Coverage depends on the surface — we confirm it on the quote.

categories.name: Joint Fillers, Sealants & Waterstops
categories.description: Bitumen-impregnated fibreboard and polyethylene joint fillers, polysulphide and polyurethane joint sealants, backer rod, PVC and hydrophilic waterstops and expansion-joint covers.
categories.handling_notes: Read the product data and safety data sheets before use: mix, apply and cure at the temperatures and rates they give, wear gloves and eye protection, and store sealed, cool and dry. Coverage depends on the surface — we confirm it on the quote. Joints are sized from the expected movement: depth about half the width, on a backer rod.

categories.name: Chemical Anchors, Epoxy & Grouts
categories.description: Polyester, vinylester and epoxy chemical-anchor cartridges, anchor studs M8 to M24, mesh sleeves, dispensing guns, epoxy mortars and grouts, and precision non-shrink grouts.
typical_uses: Fixing starter bars and holding-down bolts
Fixing to hollow and solid masonry
categories.handling_notes: Read the product data and safety data sheets before use: mix, apply and cure at the temperatures and rates they give, wear gloves and eye protection, and store sealed, cool and dry. Coverage depends on the surface — we confirm it on the quote. Chemical anchors are installed to the maker's hole size, cleaning and curing times — the anchor's design load depends on them.

categories.name: Waterproofing Systems & Tanking
categories.description: Crystalline and cementitious waterproofing, polyurethane and acrylic liquid membranes, mineral-finish torch-on in colours, HDPE and bentonite tanking membranes, protection boards and drainage sheets.
typical_uses: Basements, lift pits and retaining walls
categories.handling_notes: Read the product data and safety data sheets before use: mix, apply and cure at the temperatures and rates they give, wear gloves and eye protection, and store sealed, cool and dry. Coverage depends on the surface — we confirm it on the quote. Waterproofing systems are installed by an approved applicator for the maker's guarantee.

categories.name: Thermal Insulation & Lagging
categories.description: Extruded and expanded polystyrene and PIR insulation boards, polyester and glass-wool insulation per m², reflective foil, geyser blankets and pipe lagging from 15 to 54 mm.
typical_uses: Geysers, hot-water pipes and cold rooms
categories.handling_notes: Insulation thickness follows the climate zone and R-value in SANS 10400-XA — we confirm it on the quote. Keep foam boards away from naked flames and sunlight, and wear gloves and a mask with mineral wool.

categories.name: Fire Extinguishers, Hose Reels & Fire Stopping
categories.description: DCP, CO₂, foam and water extinguishers, hose reels and cabinets, fire blankets, photoluminescent fire signs, smoke and heat detectors, intumescent sealants, collars and fire-rated board.
categories.handling_notes: Fire installations follow SANS 10400-T and the local fire department: extinguishers and hose reels to SANS 1910 / SANS 543, serviced by an SAQCC-registered company. Fire-rated systems must be installed as tested.

categories.name: Acoustic Ceilings & Sound Insulation
categories.description: Mineral-fibre and glass-wool acoustic ceiling tiles, exposed-grid ceiling systems, acoustic insulation batts, resilient channels, acoustic sealant, mass-loaded vinyl and acoustic panels.
categories.handling_notes: Sound insulation works as a system — gaps and back-boxes let sound through, so seal every joint with acoustic sealant. Keep ceiling tiles flat and dry before installation.

categories.name: Pumps, Boreholes & Water Treatment
categories.description: Borehole and submersible pumps, pressure and booster pumps, transfer pumps, pressure tanks and controllers, solar borehole kits, water filters, UV sterilisers and softeners.
categories.handling_notes: Pumps must be wired by a registered electrician and sized for the borehole's yield and the head — send the borehole test or tank layout with the quote. Borehole water should be tested before drinking.

categories.name: Valves, Meters & HDPE Fittings
categories.description: Brass gate, ball and check valves from 15 to 50 mm, pressure-reducing valves, water meters, HDPE compression fittings from 20 to 63 mm, PEX and multilayer pipe and fittings.
categories.handling_notes: Pressure-test new lines before backfilling or closing up. Water meters on municipal connections are installed by the municipality; private meters by a registered plumber.

categories.name: Heat Pumps & Hot-Water Systems
categories.description: Domestic and commercial heat pumps, retrofit heat-pump kits, gas water heaters, geyser drip trays, valves and safety sets, geyser timers and solar geyser parts.
categories.handling_notes: Geysers and heat pumps are installed to SANS 10254 by a registered plumber, who issues a plumbing certificate of compliance; electrical connections by a registered electrician. Gas installations need a registered LP gas installer.

categories.name: Commercial & Industrial Lighting
categories.description: LED downlights and panels, battens and vapour-proof fittings, high-bays, floodlights, street and area lights, emergency lighting and exit signs, sensors and photocells.
categories.handling_notes: Lighting is installed by a registered electrician under SANS 10142-1; emergency lighting to SANS 10114-2 where required. Light levels follow SANS 10114-1 for the activity — we can confirm fittings from a layout.

categories.name: Generators, UPS & Power Protection
categories.description: Petrol, diesel and inverter generators from 2.5 to 100 kVA, automatic transfer switches, UPS units, voltage regulators, prepaid electricity meters, contactors and cable glands and lugs.
typical_uses: Backup power for homes and businesses
categories.handling_notes: Generators connected to a building's wiring need a changeover or transfer switch installed by a registered electrician, so the generator can never back-feed the grid. Run generators outdoors only.

categories.name: Glass, Safety Glass & Mirrors
categories.description: Clear and tinted float glass from 3 to 10 mm, laminated and toughened safety glass, obscure patterns, low-E and double-glazed units, and mirrors — cut to size, per m².
categories.handling_notes: Glazing must follow SANS 10400-N and SANS 10137: safety glass in doors, sidelights, low-level panes, showers and balustrades. Glass is cut to size — send the opening sizes, and allow for the frame rebate.

categories.name: Shower Enclosures & Glass Balustrades
categories.description: Frameless and framed shower doors and enclosures, walk-in screens, glass balustrade panels, spigots, standoffs and stainless handrails and fittings.
categories.handling_notes: Shower and balustrade glass must be safety glass (SANS 10400-N); balustrades must also meet the height and load rules of SANS 10400-M. We measure on site for frameless glass.

categories.name: Aluminium Sections & Shopfronts
categories.description: Aluminium angles, channels, flat bar, square and round tube in 6 m lengths, window and shopfront sections, and made-to-measure aluminium shopfronts, windows and sliding doors.
categories.handling_notes: Aluminium is cut and fabricated to the drawing; anodised and powder-coated finishes are confirmed on the quote. Keep sections wrapped until fixed to protect the finish.

categories.name: Kitchen Cabinets & Carcasses
categories.description: Melamine kitchen carcasses and units: base, drawer, sink, corner, wall and tall units from 300 to 1,200 mm, with doors in white, grey, oak and charcoal, plinths and end panels.
categories.handling_notes: Cabinets are flat-packed or assembled to order; carcass board, door finish and hardware are confirmed on the quote. Fix wall units to solid backing with the right anchors, and seal worktop cut-outs against water.

categories.name: Worktops & Built-In Appliances
categories.description: Post-formed worktops in standard lengths and depths, granite, quartz and solid-wood tops per m², and built-in hobs, ovens, extractors and stoves.
categories.handling_notes: Cabinets are flat-packed or assembled to order; carcass board, door finish and hardware are confirmed on the quote. Fix wall units to solid backing with the right anchors, and seal worktop cut-outs against water. Appliances are connected by a registered electrician (and gas by a registered LP gas installer).

categories.name: Built-In Cupboards & Cabinet Hardware
categories.description: Bedroom built-in cupboards with hinged and sliding doors from 900 to 2,700 mm, cupboard interiors, drawer runners, soft-close hinges, handles, lift-ups and wardrobe fittings.
categories.handling_notes: Cabinets are flat-packed or assembled to order; carcass board, door finish and hardware are confirmed on the quote. Fix wall units to solid backing with the right anchors, and seal worktop cut-outs against water.

categories.name: Air Conditioning
categories.description: Inverter wall-split air conditioners from 9,000 to 36,000 BTU, cassette and ducted units, multi-splits, mounting brackets, copper pair coil, drain pumps and condensate pipe.
categories.handling_notes: Air conditioners are installed by a SAQCC Gas-registered refrigeration technician (refrigerant handling) and wired by a registered electrician. Size units to the room's heat load — we confirm it on the quote.

categories.name: Ventilation, Extraction & Ducting
categories.description: Wall, window and ceiling extractor fans from 100 to 300 mm, inline duct fans, flexible and rigid ducting, vent grilles and louvres, cowls, fresh-air and industrial fans.
categories.handling_notes: Ventilation follows SANS 10400-O: rooms without opening windows need mechanical ventilation. Fans are wired by a registered electrician; commercial kitchen extraction needs a fire-rated duct design.

categories.name: Site Offices, Containers & Ablutions
categories.description: Site offices, storage and shipping containers (3, 6 and 12 m, new and used), guard huts, ablution containers, chemical toilets and handwash stations — for sale or hire.
categories.handling_notes: Site establishment items are sold or hired through our partners; hire rates, minimum periods, delivery and collection are confirmed on the quote. Sites must comply with the Construction Regulations (2014).

categories.name: Temporary Fencing, Hoarding & Site Signs
categories.description: Mesh temporary fence panels and bases, crowd barriers, chromadek and IBR site hoarding per metre, scaffold and shade netting, and construction site boards and safety signs.
categories.handling_notes: Site establishment items are sold or hired through our partners; hire rates, minimum periods, delivery and collection are confirmed on the quote. Sites must comply with the Construction Regulations (2014).

categories.name: Site Power, Lighting & Distribution
categories.description: Site distribution boxes, industrial plugs and sockets, extension reels from 20 to 50 m, lighting towers, site floodlights and work lights, festoon lighting and cable protectors.
categories.handling_notes: Temporary site installations are wired by a registered electrician, with earth leakage on every circuit. Keep leads off the ground and away from water, and inspect them daily.

categories.name: Site Consumables & Cleaning
categories.description: Black and clear plastic sheeting, builder's rubble and refuse bags, hessian, danger tape, buckets, brooms and squeegees, spray paint, cleaning chemicals and site hygiene supplies.
categories.handling_notes: Keep the site clean and clear as the Construction Regulations require — housekeeping prevents most trips and falls. Store chemicals with their safety data sheets.

categories.name: Power Tools & Cordless Kits
categories.description: Corded and cordless drills, hammer and SDS drills, angle grinders 115 to 230 mm, circular and mitre saws, jigsaws, demolition breakers, wall chasers, tile cutters, planers, sanders and nailers.
categories.handling_notes: Use power tools with the guards fitted and the PPE the maker specifies (eye, hearing and dust protection). Make and model are confirmed on the quote; equipment can also be hired through plant hire.

categories.name: Drill Bits, Discs & Diamond Blades
categories.description: Masonry, SDS-plus, SDS-max, HSS and wood drill bits, core bits, chisels, metal and stone cutting discs, flap discs, diamond blades for concrete, tile, asphalt and granite, and saw blades.
typical_uses: Cutting steel, brick, tile and concrete
categories.handling_notes: Match the disc or blade to the material and the tool's speed rating, never use a damaged or out-of-date disc, and keep the guard on. Wear eye protection and a dust mask when cutting masonry.

categories.name: Concrete & Compaction Equipment
categories.description: Concrete mixers from 120 to 350 L, plate compactors, rammers, poker vibrators and shafts, power floats and trowels, screed rails, vibrating screeds, block-making machines and water pumps.
typical_uses: Compacting trenches, paving bases and fills
categories.handling_notes: Use power tools with the guards fitted and the PPE the maker specifies (eye, hearing and dust protection). Make and model are confirmed on the quote; equipment can also be hired through plant hire. Compaction plant is used with hearing protection and away from trench edges.

categories.name: Levels, Lasers & Measuring Tools
categories.description: Spirit levels from 300 mm to 2.4 m, cross-line and rotary lasers, laser distance meters, tape measures, moisture meters, cable and stud detectors, squares and straightedges.
typical_uses: Setting out walls, ceilings and tiles
categories.handling_notes: Check spirit levels and lasers against a known level before important work, and store them in their cases.

categories.name: Carpet, Carpet Tiles & Commercial Flooring
categories.description: Broadloom carpet and carpet tiles, commercial vinyl sheet and safety flooring, rubber gym flooring, epoxy and polyurethane floor systems, stair nosings and floor-preparation compounds.
categories.handling_notes: Floors go down on a clean, dry, level screed: test the slab's moisture before vinyl or carpet and prime as the maker specifies. Commercial floors are installed by an approved contractor.

categories.name: CCTV, Access Control & Alarms
categories.description: CCTV cameras and recorders, PoE switches, hard drives, intercoms and video door stations, access-control keypads, readers and maglocks, alarm panels, PIR detectors, sirens and electric-fence energisers.
categories.handling_notes: Security systems are installed by a PSIRA-registered installer; electrical connections by a registered electrician. Electric fences need an Electric Fence System Certificate (SANS 10222-3).

categories.name: Industrial Fixings, Rivets & Nails by Weight
categories.description: High-tensile bolts and nuts by grade, coach screws, through bolts, rivets and rivet guns, roofing and wire nails by the kilogram, shot-fired pins and washers.
categories.handling_notes: Bolts are matched to the engineer's grade (8.8 or 10.9) and torque; never mix grades. Nails sold by the kilogram are packed in the nearest bag size.

categories.name: Industrial & Protective Coatings
categories.description: Zinc-rich and epoxy primers, high-build epoxy and polyurethane topcoats, chlorinated-rubber and road-marking-grade coatings, heat-resistant and anti-corrosion paints, galvanising repair, tank linings and wood finishes.
categories.handling_notes: Industrial coatings follow the specified system (surface preparation, primer, build and topcoat) and SANS 12944 corrosivity class. Apply within the temperature and humidity limits on the data sheet.

categories.name: Wendy Houses, Sheds & Steel Carports
categories.description: Timber Wendy houses from 2 × 2 to 6 × 6 m in log-lap, shiplap and nutec, steel garden and storage sheds, steel carports and garages — supplied and erected.
typical_uses: Backyard rooms, offices and staff quarters
categories.handling_notes: Prefab buildings are delivered and erected by the supplier on a level, prepared base (slab or plinths) — the quote confirms the base, access for delivery and what's included. Buildings beyond the National Building Regulations' exemptions need municipal approval.

categories.name: Light Steel Frame Building Systems
categories.description: Light-gauge steel studs, tracks and noggins in 89 and 140 mm, LSF roof trusses, building wrap, OSB and fibre-cement sheathing, fixings, and LSF building kits quoted per m².
categories.handling_notes: Light steel frame buildings are designed by an engineer to SANS 517 and erected by an accredited contractor; the NHBRC requires LSF homes to be enrolled like any other.

categories.name: Modular & Container Buildings
categories.description: Modular classrooms, clinics, offices and ablution blocks, container conversions, panel-built site camps and park homes — designed, delivered and installed to order.
typical_uses: Mines, construction camps and remote sites
categories.handling_notes: Prefab buildings are delivered and erected by the supplier on a level, prepared base (slab or plinths) — the quote confirms the base, access for delivery and what's included. Buildings beyond the National Building Regulations' exemptions need municipal approval.

categories.name: Farm Fencing, Gates & Cattle Grids
categories.description: Galvanised farm gates from 2.4 to 6 m, game and stock fencing, Bonnox-type field fence, high-tensile and smooth wire, strainer and corner posts, staples, droppers, cattle grids and wire tools.
categories.handling_notes: Fence lines are strained from braced strainer and corner posts; check boundary positions before fencing. Electric fencing on farms follows SANS 60335-2-76 for the energiser.

categories.name: Troughs, Dam Liners & Farm Water
categories.description: Plastic and concrete drinking troughs, ball and float valves, HDPE dam liners per m², farm water tanks, reservoir tanks, windpump parts and stock-water pipe.
categories.handling_notes: Dam liners are welded and installed by a specialist on a prepared, stone-free base. Check water-use authorisation for new dams with the Department of Water and Sanitation.

categories.name: Shade Net, Tunnels & Crop Protection
categories.description: Agricultural shade net from 20 to 80%, hail and bird net, greenhouse film, tunnel kits, poly-tunnel hoops and fittings, ground cover and mulch film.
categories.handling_notes: Tension nets on a frame designed for wind load, and replace greenhouse film at the end of its UV life (typically 3–4 seasons).

categories.name: Steel Grating, Stair Treads & Walkways
categories.description: Galvanised serrated and plain steel floor grating, stair treads, walkway panels, expanded-metal and perforated sheet, handrail standards and kick plates — cut and banded to size.
categories.handling_notes: Mining and industrial products are supplied to the buyer's specification and the Mine Health and Safety Act's requirements; send the specification, drawing or tender reference with the quote. Grating is clipped or welded down as the design requires.

categories.name: Mining Consumables & Underground Support
categories.description: Shotcrete and gunite mixes, roof-bolting mesh, rock bolts and resin capsules, roof-support packs, brattice cloth, ventilation ducting, underground signage and mining PPE.
categories.handling_notes: Mining and industrial products are supplied to the buyer's specification and the Mine Health and Safety Act's requirements; send the specification, drawing or tender reference with the quote.

categories.name: Industrial Flooring, Linings & Wear Protection
categories.description: Heavy-duty epoxy and polyurethane-cement floors, chemical-resistant linings, acid-resistant bricks and mortars, wear-resistant ceramic and rubber linings, bund coatings and anti-slip treatments.
categories.handling_notes: Mining and industrial products are supplied to the buyer's specification and the Mine Health and Safety Act's requirements; send the specification, drawing or tender reference with the quote.
